FULL TEXT:
STENOGRAPHER RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION, 2025
NOTICE
No.- 09/R&A Dated: 19th February, 2026
The result of the Written Test under Stenographer Recruitment Examination, 2025 was
declared vide this Court’s Notice No.07/R&A dated 30.01.2026, whereby 210 candidates have
been shortlisted for appearing at the interview.
The interview of these shortlisted candidates shall be conducted from
10.03.2026 to 12.03.2026 and 16.03.2026 to 19.03.2026, within the premises of the Court.
The exact date of interview, reporting time, and venue shall be mentioned in their
respective Admit Cards (Interview Letters). They are advised to report as per schedule
mentioned in their respective Admit Cards (Interview Letters) failing which they may
not be allowed to appear at the interview.
Admit Card would not be sent to the candidates separately through any other mode. The
shortlisted candidates will be intimated through e-mail/SMS on their registered e-mail ID/mobile
number in this regard.
No request for change in the schedule of interview shall be entertained.
Candidates are advised to ensure that they are in possession of original documents
relating to minimum educational qualification to be produced during interview failing which
their candidature will be cancelled. They are also advised to bring certificates pertaining to
Domicile, OH Status, Caste, Non-Creamy Layer for BC & EBC, Income & Asset Certificate
(EWS), as prescribed in the advertisement in support of the claim they have made in their online
application form, failing which they will not be considered for grant of benefits admissible to that
particular caste and category and candidature of such candidates will be considered / assessed
under the Unreserved category across all stages of this recruitment exercise.
The Admit Card for appearing at the interview will be made available from 23.02.2026,
therefore, the candidates are advised to keep visiting the Court’s official website i.e.
https://patnahighcourt.gov.in/notices/recruitments regularly for further details / updates.
By order of the Court
Sd/- P. K. Malik
Registrar General
